_doc: Resource groups for the Materials section. Item 'status' is one of: available, coming, in-progress, external. Give 'url' only for real, public destinations; omit it (or set null) for unreleased items. Use 'attribution' for third-party resources. 'pendingUrl' keeps a destination on file for an item whose public page is not live yet; move it to 'url' and set status 'available' once it resolves (node build.js --check-links verifies external links).

platform.title: Two platforms
platform.text: Week 1 uses Berkeley Humanoid Lite, an open-source humanoid from the Hybrid Robotics group at UC Berkeley with modular 3D-printed cycloidal actuators, as the actuator and introductory platform: every student builds a BHL-style actuator, and a prepared BHL-like mechanism walks on student-built actuators by Friday. From Week 2 the course moves to the Metal2Humanoid, a larger custom humanoid (provisionally 26 actuated joints) assembled and commissioned by the six teams. Its CAD and actuator selection are being finalized before January. Berkeley Humanoid Lite's software is MIT-licensed and its hardware files are CC BY-SA 4.0.
